text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Ivory long-sleeve soft cotton Henley with short button placket and pushed-up sleeves, charcoal fine-pinstripe extremely wide fluid trousers and white gray low-top sneakers.. Add ONLY these accessories: Plain black canvas shoulder tote with wide long shoulder strap; Black rounded rectangular optical eyeglasses, clear lenses, unfolded temples; Silver round-dial wristwatch on metal bracelet, dark dial, complete bracelet. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Plain black canvas shoulder tote with wide long shoulder strap; 2. Black rounded rectangular optical eyeglasses, clear lenses, unfolded temples; 3. Silver round-dial wristwatch on metal bracelet, dark dial, complete bracelet. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
